Thanks Priya — leaving this in ops lane. Quick proposal: allow a temporary invoice-only onboarding for pilots under $7,500 for up to 60 days subject to the following evidence checklist:
- Completed vendor onboarding form (received)
- W-9 or TAX ID (required)

Marissa — thanks. Finance is generally comfortable with a temporary invoice-only pathway for one-off pilots under $5k with a few extra guardrails. Given this ask is ~$4.2k, I can approve but would like the following controls applied:

Approve with conditions — I support a temporary exception for this pilot but narrower guardrails:
1) Approve invoice-only onboarding for up to 60 days and up to $5,000 total spend.
2) Signed SOW must be executed (DocuSign) and uploaded to the vendor record before the vendor sends the first invoice.
3) W-9 and basic insurance documentation on file. If any of these are missing, do not accept invoices.
4) Ops to add automatic vendor expiry and an owner for follow-up 10 days before expiry.
5) Sales to include a clause in the SOW that requires a PO if the relationship moves to production or beyond the pilot term.

Priya — please confirm acceptance with the vendor and obtain DocuSign link. Marissa / Ben — please implement the temporary tag and the spend alerts. I'll review any next-step escalations if threshold is hit.
